fields.Name: T176 - API Key Creation Wizard
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke two-step slide-out wizard (Step 'configure' -> 'scopes' via goToScopes()) with a step indicator and scope-category picker — a custom flow entirely separate from the generic entity create form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and switch to the Admin application, then open 'Identity & Access' and select the 'API Keys' sub-section from the left navigation. Click the 'Generate New Key' button (top-right, or the 'Generate Key' quick action). A slide-out wizard titled 'Generate New API Key' should open on step 1 (Configure). Type a label such as 'Regression Test Key' in the Key Label field, then click 'Next: Permissions' to advance to step 2 where permission scope categories are listed. Seeing the wizard advance to the Permissions step is success — you do NOT need to actually generate the key. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Generate New API Key' slide-out opens showing step 1 (Configure) with a Key Label field and a step indicator (Configure / Permissions)
After typing a label and clicking 'Next: Permissions', the wizard advances to the scope-selection step showing permission scope categories (or a loading/empty scopes state)
The step indicator reflects the move from step 1 to step 2
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
